title: E-Commerce Promotional Graphics & Pinterest Brand Kits
summary: High-converting social media creatives, Pinterest pin packs, promotional banner variants, and brand style guides designed in Canva.
problem: E-commerce stores require continuous, high-volume visual collateral adhering to platform-specific aspect ratios (2:3 for Pinterest, 1:1 for Instagram) without slow design turnarounds.
whatIDid: Designed 25+ responsive Canva templates for product feature spotlights, seasonal sale discounts, and customer review highlights.
Engineered cohesive color palettes, typography pairings, and reusable asset libraries for quick batch generation.
Formulated Pinterest-optimized 1000x1500px pins with high-contrast text overlays and prominent call-to-action tabs.
Exported clean asset folders organized by campaign date and platform resolution requirements.
result: Assembled an organized, production-ready e-commerce creative asset kit [PORTFOLIO DESIGN SAMPLE].
